Document.p: Markets distribute food and finished goods to homes and route labor and raw materials to local businesses. A pottery can receive ore, coal and workers from a staffed market, then return finished goods.

Local trade reaches up to 14 tiles from the market footprint. Adjacent transport connects the market to the wider freight network. A connected warehouse can replenish food, goods, coal, ore and steel from farther away.

Open the market with the Query tool and select it again to edit stock rules. Receive locally lets stock enter the market. Supply locally lets existing stock leave for local homes, businesses and transport. For outside trade, use Import or Export at a port.
This means the trade is allowed.

A market consumes labor in order to trade any other commodities. The number of labor consumed is dependent on the inventory of all commodities at the market.
If a market has more than 85% waste, then it will burn 2867 waste and produce 204 pollution.
